Hi everyone — I'm Ovidiu, an independent researcher passionate about quantum foundations and gravitational theory.

I recently completed a Lean 4 formalization of a geometric response framework connecting quantum structural dynamics to gravitational scales via Green–Kubo relaxation times and Kramers–Kronig causality constraints.

The formalization is zero axioms, zero sorries, and covers:

  • GK→KK necessity (200+ lines of tactics, full dominated convergence proof)
  • Debye sufficiency (transform convergence + passivity)
  • Flat-space conservation for polynomial-in-□ operators
  • Operational scales (ωG, λG, mG) emerging from τG
  • OU exemplar as concrete instantiation

A companion Rocq/Coq development handles the Quantum Structural Triad layer (ΠA = √FQ · S · I).

The Lean proofs were developed with significant LLM assistance for syntax — happy to discuss that workflow openly.

GitHub: https://github.com/apprenticeO/geometric-response
